local_freeze.scope: local working-tree freeze only; not an independently timestamped preregistration
local_freeze.refreeze_reason: independent pre-run audit added rescorable raw actions, a fail-stop watchdog, exact v2 case-order defaults, and full-stack 512-token structured export parity

supersession.reason: The live browser runner was intentionally upgraded to a cache-bearing autoregressive prefill/decode ABI before this local-only protocol received an external timestamp or collected any corrected-condition runs.
supersession.replacement_protocol_status: must be frozen from the final trained bundle and current runner before any new latency or capability collection

purpose: Measure natural-context structured-action quality with a fixed 512-token graph compute load after correcting the SFT-to-browser decision-feature contract.

prior_failed_condition.treatment: real unmasked single-token spaces inserted before the assistant marker; structured heads consumed hidden[input_tokens - 1]
prior_failed_condition.interpretation: Preserve as a pre-assistant-padding stress result. Do not reinterpret it as the corrected fixed-compute condition.

feature_contract.materialization: append single-token spaces after the complete natural prompt until input_tokens equals 512
feature_contract.not_claimed: quality after conditioning on 512 meaningful context tokens

offline_packaging_invariance_audit.required_observation: natural and fixed_trailing_compute_512 preserve route and selector counts on both frozen evaluation sets

full_stack_structured_export_parity.required_observation: native PyTorch, ONNX fp32, and ONNX fp16 agree exactly on route, selected tool, learned pointer spans, grounded typed arguments, and normalized action for all 20 reused action cases

browser_conditions.watchdog_scope: every warmup and measured policy call
browser_conditions.timeout_contract: a timeout aborts the entire page collection and preserves an incomplete downloadable payload; ONNX Runtime Web inference is not cancellable, so no subsequent policy call starts

required_record_checks: action_timeout_ms equals 10000 and timeout metadata states fail-stop whole-collection semantics
each row preserves normalized predicted_action, full expected_action, parse_evidence, and independent_schema including validator errors and the selected tool schema
offline aggregation recomputes exact tool, arguments, action, and schema validity and rejects any stored alias that disagrees
graph, checkpoint, tokenizer, dispatch-head, pointer-head, suite, and runner identities match this protocol

action: tool-required exact accuracy separated from abstention
route, selected tool, normalized arguments/action, parse evidence, and independent validation for every case
dom: TTFA and closed-loop p50, p95, and p99
report.aggregation: preserve all raw rows; lead capability with unique-case denominators; treat the 30 repetitions as timing precision rather than independent capability trials; report pooled descriptive latency and median/range of the three within-run percentiles

limitations: single SFT training seed; 10,524,544 backbone parameters plus 2,499,333 active learned structured heads
single Apple Metal-3 Chrome/WebGPU environment; per-node ORT placement remains unknown
the 20-case action suite, 8-case DOM suite, and 65-row eval set were inspected during diagnosis, so corrected runs are deployment-parity re-evaluations rather than untouched capability confirmation
only one action-suite case expects abstention, so abstention generalization is effectively unmeasured
text and semantic-DOM grounding rather than vision, trusted OS input, or BrowserGym
corrected condition measures fixed compute, not 512 tokens of meaningful conditioning context
local freeze has no independent pre-outcome timestamp until the required external timestamp is created
